content: Advance M0120/W0123 by making the lifecycle Coordinator's public control-plane operations safe under concurrent lifecycle requests and read-only open/mmap/submit/telemetry observations. Preserve one serialized authority, generation/tombstone invariants, and callback reentrancy without changing the transport ABI.

Coordinator operations use one recursive control mutex because apply invokes snapshot while holding authority and mirror callbacks may take read-only snapshots. Public state accessors and mutation entry points share the same lock; internal apply_* helpers remain unlocked and are reachable only from the locked apply path. A move constructor preserves existing test factories while a live Coordinator remains non-copyable.

Content revision f8a786a adds recursive control-plane serialization to Coordinator, locks public mutation/read accessors, and supplies a locked move constructor for existing factory-return patterns. Lifecycle README and W0123 plan record that transport payload and provider fence synchronization remain separate owners.

The lifecycle long-run fixture now races four identical reset replays, then runs 128 reset/remove/add cycles while open, mmap, submit-replay, and telemetry-style observer threads access the authority. It proves one Accepted and three Duplicate results, legal intermediate states, final generation/tombstone invariants, and full development CTest passed 83/83.
